# Copilot instructions

## Build, test, and lint

- Use Node.js 24 LTS, as specified in `README.md`.
- `npm install` installs dependencies.
- `npm run dev` starts the Vite development server.
- `npm run lint` runs Oxlint with the React and Oxc plugins.
- `npx oxlint src/App.jsx` lints a single file when you need a focused check.
- `npm run build` creates the production site in `dist/`.
- `npm run preview` serves the production build locally.
- No test script or test framework is configured in `package.json`, so there is no single-test command.

## Architecture

- `index.html` provides the `#root` mount point; `src/main.jsx` mounts `App` inside React `StrictMode` and imports the global stylesheet.
- `src/App.jsx` renders a single Korean introduction page for the nickname `침팬치0호`. The `sections` array defines header navigation to `#about`, `#interests`, `#skills`, `#works`, and `#goals`.
- Only the nickname and interest in games/digital activities have been confirmed. Strengths, learning interests, activities, and goals have explicit pending states; do not invent personal details or achievements.
- `src/App.css` contains component and responsive layout styles; `src/index.css` defines global styles and CSS custom properties.
- Static assets belong in `public/`; Vite serves them from the site root.
- Production output is generated by Vite into `dist/` and includes `index.html` plus bundled assets.

## Repository conventions

- Keep page navigation as ordinary hash links. `useSyncExternalStore` subscribes to `hashchange`; the `useEffect` in `App` synchronizes the document title, scroll position, and focus when the hash changes.
- Preserve section deep links and browser back/forward behavior. Legacy `#/about` links target the introduction; `#/portfolio` and its former detail links target the activities section.
- The game-inspired design uses dark panels, lime accents, purple highlights, and a CSS avatar. `--accent`, `--text`, `--muted`, and `--line` are defined in `src/index.css`.
- Preserve the split between `App.css` component styles and `index.css` global tokens, base rules, and accessibility behavior.
- Oxlint is configured in `.oxlintrc.json` with the React and Oxc plugins; React hook rule violations are errors.

See `README.md` for the template setup and user-facing run instructions.
